blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following is the valid way to display Welcome to Programiz on the screen?
Tap an option below to answer:
System.out.println(Welcome to Programiz); causes an error because we have not enclosed Welcome to Programiz inside double quotes "".
System.out.println(Welcome to Programiz); causes an error because we have not enclosed Welcome to Programiz inside double quotes "".
System.out.println"Welcome to Programiz"; causes an error because we have not enclosed "Welcome to Programiz" inside parentheses ().
System.out.println"Welcome to Programiz"; causes an error because we have not enclosed "Welcome to Programiz" inside parentheses ().
System.out.println("Welcome to Programiz"); displays Welcome to Programiz on the screen.
System.out.println("Welcome to Programiz"); displays Welcome to Programiz on the screen.
System.out.println("Welcome to Programiz") results in an error because ; at the end is mandatory in Java.
System.out.println("Welcome to Programiz") results in an error because ; at the end is mandatory in Java.
